application_conditions: "Open to all users, regardless of sign-up date" (help centre); start from ether.fi/app/cash/affiliate (an ether.fi account is implied); no approval step described. Official Affiliate Program Terms (effective 2026-04-23): referrer and referred user must be 18+, reside where ether.fi services and the Program are available, complete KYC, and hold an ether.fi Cash vault to be paid. Multiple referral links with custom names/tags allowed. The legacy 1 % Referral Program ended 2026-10-15; the Affiliate Program is now the only referral programme.
paid_action: Help centre: qualifying referral = sign-up through the link + Cash card activation + ≥ $100 USD eligible personal spending (excluded: ATM withdrawals, cash advances, P2P transfers, currency exchange, gift/stored-value cards, financial/investment transactions, gambling). Terms (2026-04-23): sign-up through the unique link within 90 days of the link being generated, apply for and activate the ether.fi Card, begin qualifying net card purchases within 30 days of activation (excluding fees, credit adjustments, returns, refunds, ATM withdrawals, cash equivalents); a minimum purchase amount "may" be set. Card activation and spend are the paid actions, which fits a card comparator.
validation_conditions: Referral must activate the Cash card and reach $100+ eligible personal spend (help centre; the terms say "begin qualifying purchases within 30 days of activation" and reserve a minimum). Rewards credited after transactions settle; refunded/ineligible transactions do not count. Tier upgrades require both all-time and rolling-90-day referral counts (Tier 2: 50 / 10; Tier 3: 100 / 20; Tier 4: 500 / 50), recalculated monthly from the month of the first qualifying referral. A month's rewards must exceed $1 to be distributed.

commission.model_note: Tiered hybrid (help centre table, re-read 2026-11-17): new-member bonus $10 / $15 / $20 / $20 and high-spender bonus $15 / $20 / $25 / $25 per qualifying referral (Tier 1–4); cashback on referral spending 0.1 % / 0.2 % / 0.25 % / 0.3 %; physical-card commission 20 / 20 / 20 / 25 %; card-fee commission 50 % all tiers; Liquid and staked yield revenue share 5 / 7.5 / 10 / 12.5 %; 20 % second-degree revshare from Tier 2. "No cap on the number of people you can refer or on how long you keep earning." The official Terms state no rate or amount themselves.
commission.tiers_note: Tier 1 figures recorded as the base (amount = new-member bonus). Page's '$867,000' figure is a projection for 500 referrals/month, stated as an estimate.

revenue_share.included_products: Card fees (50%), physical cards (20–25%), referral spending cashback (0.1–0.3%), Liquid and staked yield (5–12.5%).

payout.method: USDC (or another supported asset) "directly into your Vault with Cash" — an ether.fi Cash vault is required
payout.frequency: Monthly, in the following calendar month; help centre: by midnight Central Time on the 15th of the following month
payout.holdbacks_note: ether.fi may delay or withhold payment while verifying eligibility or investigating suspected fraud/abuse, and may "withhold, reverse, or reclaim any rewards earned in violation of these terms". Taxes are the participant's responsibility (Form 1099-MISC may be issued).
payout.cancellation_note: ether.fi may modify or terminate the Program at any time; continued participation after changes constitutes acceptance.

rules_note: Official ether.fi Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions (etherfi.gitbook.io, effective April 23, 2026) read for the first time on 2026-11-17 — the record previously relied on the general Terms of Use. Prohibited: self-referrals or multiple accounts; deceptive or misleading marketing; "posting referral links in paid ads without authorization"; gaming or farming referral/cashback rewards; bots, scripts or automation to generate sign-ups. Programme limited to jurisdictions where the card is offered and ether.fi is authorised (no list); governing law/arbitration per the ether.fi Terms of Use. "Additional program rules may apply." David's referral link https://www.ether.fi/@6fe89e3c (ether.fi account holder, activated 2026-11-07) is used on the website only — no paid ads, no spam — which is consistent with the terms. The legacy Referral Program ended 2026-10-15.
allowed_countries_note: Not listed; participation limited to places where the ether.fi Card is offered and ether.fi is authorised to operate; ether.fi may restrict access by local regulation or risk.
